claims.assertion: Yazhi says humans, Taygetans, and Engans are Lyrian in origin, but humans have distinct brain and nervous-system development and lack telepathy and extrasensory perception.
claims.speaker: Yazhi
claims.qualifiers: She says humans are considered secondary by some, while Andromedans reportedly regard their genetics as superior.

claims.assertion: Yazhi describes the Swaruunian line as a Taygetan offshoot sharing a group genome while each individual retains distinct DNA.
claims.speaker: Yazhi
claims.qualifiers: She says the line's shared genome helps define it as a separate race.
